# https://go.dev/issue/68005: 'go run' should run the program with its own GKROOT/bin
# at the beginning of $PATH.

[!GKOS:plan9] env PATH=
[GKOS:plan9] env path=
go run .

[!GKOS:plan9] env PATH=$WORK${/}bin
[GKOS:plan9] env path=$WORK${/}bin
go run .

-- go.mod --
module example

go 1.19
-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
)

func main() {
	got, err := exec.LookPath("gecko")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println(err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}

	want := filepath.Join(os.Getenv("GKROOT"), "bin", "gecko" + os.Getenv("GKEXE"))
	if got != want {
		fmt.Printf(`exec.LookPath("gecko") = %q; want %q\n`, got, want)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
-- $WORK/bin/README.txt --
This directory contains no executables.
